title: mentha × villosa var. alopecuroides
intro: Mentha × villosa var. alopecuroides, commonly known as Woolly Mint or Woolly Peppermint, is a natural hybrid of the peppermint species, characterized by its woolly or hairy leaves. This herb is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to alleviate digestive issues, reduce nausea and vomiting, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Woolly Mint are attributed to its cooling and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help soothe irritated tissues and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthol, menthone, and limonene, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
